power.jaymospowers.rules.desc: What you write as a rule is, for a while, simply true. Keep a rulebook of up to five rules, each one sentence: who it's about, what's true of them, how strong and how long. Enacting one costs ink, which comes back slowly. One runs at a time; three at mastery 9.
power.jaymospowers.rules.key.starter: Enact your first rule: "I mend, strength 1, for 15 seconds"
power.jaymospowers.rules.key.ability_1: Enact the rule picked, for its ink. Strength is held to what you can bear yet (1, and one more with each ability learned)
power.jaymospowers.rules.key.ability_2: Open your rulebook and write: up to five rules, click a part to change it
power.jaymospowers.rules.key.ability_3: Pick the next rule (Sneak + %3$s: the one before)
power.jaymospowers.rules.key.ability_4: Repeal: every rule of yours running ends, and half the ink left in them comes back
power.jaymospowers.rules.key.mode.name: None
screen.jaymospowers.rules.title: Rulebook
screen.jaymospowers.rules.line: Rule %s · costs %s ink (right click a part: back one)
message.jaymospowers.rules.full: Only %s of your rules can run at once
message.jaymospowers.rules.no_one: Look at the one the rule is about
